title: Security response retainer and evidence crediting tiers for enterprise onramp
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary: Create a packaged offering and experiment to speed enterprise contract completion by combining a monthly security response retainer (fast access to canned/curated SIG/CAIQ answers and a dedicated response slot) with a consumable evidence credit model that customers can buy/commit to. The goal is to reduce average time-to-contract for enterprise deals that require questionnaire responses, reduce legal/SE handoffs, and create a predictable revenue stream tied to support effort.

Background and problem: Sales and legal teams report long lead times for customers requiring SIG/CAIQ and bespoke evidence. Current approaches are ad-hoc: expensive concierge engagements or slow self-serve exports. This causes friction on large ARR deals and increases SE time. Several prior pilots (attestation bundles and evidence credits) show demand but lack packaged retainer pricing and clear UX for tracking credit consumption.

Objectives:
- Ship a viable pricing/packaging prototype for Q2 that combines: (1) a monthly retainer tier (Bronze/Silver/Gold) that guarantees response SLAs and includes a base number of evidence credits; (2) add-on evidence credit packs for overage.
- Measure impact on contract velocity (days between opportunity stage Qualified -> Closed Won for RFP customers) and reduction in SE/PM time per deal.
- Validate commercial appetite via a 6-week sales pilot with 6 target customers.

Key user journeys and product touchpoints:
- Sales flow: pricing sheet with retainer tiers and credit bundles; auto-generated short-form SOW for retainer add-on; linked to quotes in CRM.
- Self-serve console: customers can view remaining credits, download assembled evidence packages (CAIQ snippets, SOC/ISO links, signed attestations), and request a high-priority response slot for bespoke questions.
- Backend: ticket generation in the security responder queue with priority mapping, credit decrement events in billing, and audit log entries for evidence exports.

Pricing experiment matrix:
- Retainer tiers (monthly): Bronze $2,000 (5 credits, 5 business-day SLA), Silver $6,000 (20 credits, 3 business-day SLA), Gold $15,000 (60 credits, 1 business-day SLA + 2 on-demand analyst hours).
- Credit add-ons: 10 credits for $1,250, 50 credits for $5,000 (volume discount).
- Experiment cells: test two price points for Silver/Gold in pilot vs control (current ad-hoc pricing) to measure conversion and renewal intent.

Success metrics (primary/secondary):
- Primary: mean days-to-contract for pilot cohort (target: 30% reduction vs baseline), pilot conversion (pilot customers purchasing retainer >= 50%), churn/renewal signal at 90 days >= 70%.
- Secondary: average SE hours saved per closed deal, number of evidence exports per customer, cost per evidence credit vs operational cost.

Implementation plan and milestones:
- Week 1-2: finalize pricing slate, create sales one-pager, update contract SOW templates (Legal + RevOps).
- Week 3: instrument crediting events and usage dashboard in Console; build endpoint for evidence export packaging.
- Week 4: internal playbook and training for SEs, security responders, and CSMs.
- Week 5-10: run 6-week pilot with 6 customers, collect qualitative feedback, and measure metrics.
- Post-pilot: iterate pricing, automate parts of evidence assembly, propose GA timeline.

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: Underpriced credits leading to support cost overrun. Mitigation: cap pilot to known customers and perform weekly burn-rate checks; require manual approval for large exports during pilot.
- Risk: Legal/regulatory objections to pre-packaged attestations. Mitigation: involve legal early; include explicit disclaimers and per-customer customization options.
- Risk: UX complexity in Console. Mitigation: ship minimal UI with key telemetry and expand based on feedback.

Stakeholders and reviewers: Sales (Kara Nguyen), RevOps (Diego Morales), Legal (Priya Sharma), Security responders (SRE: Marco Ruiz), Finance (Elsa Kim), Console eng (ENG-8452 contact: Miguel Torres).

Artifacts and links:
- Pricing one-pager (drive): https://drive.redwood.ai/Enterprise/Sec-Retainer-Pricing-Q2
- Draft SOW template (confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENT/Security+Retainer+SOW
- Console dashboard prototype: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/attestation-credits-pilot
- Implementation GH spike: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2345

Open questions for planning meeting:
1) Should credits be consumed per exported document or per underlying evidence item? Recommendation: per evidence item for predictable burn.
2) Does Gold include SLA credits that auto-queue an analyst for in-depth evidence gathering? Recommendation: yes, but require 2-hour block allocation per month.
3) What is acceptable refund/rollover policy for unused credits? Recommendation: pilot: no rollover; evaluate after pilot.

Acceptance criteria for pilot launch:
- Pricing sheet and SOW approved by Legal and Finance.
- Billing events for credit purchases and usage instrumented and tested in sandbox.
- Console shows credit balance, recent consumption events, and export links.
- Security responder playbook and triage SLA documented.

Longer-term vision: If pilot succeeds, fold retainer and evidence-crediting into the standard Enterprise catalog, add metered API for automated evidence assembly, and explore per-section attestation microbilling for high-volume customers.
